The EU Council has adopted a 13th package of sanctions against Russia over its invasion of Ukraine. The package targets 106 individuals and 88 organizations involved in Russia's aggression against Ukraine. According to the statement, the list includes companies from India, Sri Lanka, China, Serbia, Kazakhstan, Thailand and Türkiye. (Karar)

 

European countries, which have significantly increased their imports of liquefied natural gas (LNG) over the last two years to overcome the energy crisis, spent ¬171.5 billion on LNG imports during this period, ¬75.1 billion of which went to the U.S. (Yeni ^afak)

 

The Biden administration said it has imposed new trade restrictions on 93 entities from Russia, China, Türkiye, the UAE, Kyrgyzstan, India, and South Korea for supporting Russia's war effort in Ukraine. The action, one day before the second anniversary of Russia's invasion of Ukraine, essentially bans U.S. shipments to the targeted entities, including 63 from Russia, 16 from Türkiye, eight from China, and four from the UAE. (T24)

 

Ayd1nl1k columnist 0smet Özçelik wrote, The U.S. is losing in Ukraine. In fact, it is more accurate to say has lost. And this is driving them crazy. When they lost in the field, they embraced sanctions. They are playing all their trump cards. These are the latest decisions. They increased the sanctions even more. The U.S. Commerce Department ... imposed trade restrictions on 93 more companies. 16 of them are Turkish. The U.S. is using Türkiye's weaknesses. Encouraged by their search for money in the West, it has increased its pressure through sanctions. Banks and companies are threatened. The government can t resist enough. It does everything it is asked to do. The current situation is worrying.

 

Stressing that the plastics sector ranks first in Türkiye's export ranking to Russia, Recyclers and Reclaimers Association (GEKADER) founding President Fatih Eren said that there has been a 23% increase in exports to Russia this year compared to last year but that recycling facilities can t collect from Russian banks due to the U.S. sanctions.  (Dünya)

 

In a show of solidarity, the prime ministers of Italy, Canada, Belgium and the European Commission president traveled to Kyiv earlier this week. "Never give up" was NATO's message. (Hürriyet)

 

The war in Ukraine has depleted stocks in NATO countries. In the meantime, Europe has seen more clearly that it is dependent on the U.S. for arms. (Milat)

 

Two years into Russia-Ukraine war, some UN Security Council countries called on Russia to withdraw from Ukraine and end the war. (Milat)

 

INTERNATIONAL

 

Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro said on X, "Excellent meeting with the Foreign Minister of Türkiye Hakan Fidan. With the sister nation of Türkiye we are consolidating a strong friendship with a hard working agenda, concrete agreements and tangible achievements that in action and practice are for the shared welfare of our peoples. Let us continue on this path together. (TRT Haber)

 

Türkiye has played a major role helping Palestinians achieve victory against Israel, Venezuela's FM Yvan Gil said. Gil said they were "proud" of Turkish President Erdogan's stance on Palestine. (Yeni ^afak)

 

Venezuela has an extremely important place in Türkiye s policies in the region, FM Hakan Fidan said. (Sputnik Türkiye)

 

The Antalya Diplomacy Forum will take place next month with the participation of more than 20 heads of state and government from more than 100 countries, the Foreign Ministry announced. (TRT Haber)

 

Vice President Cevdet Y1lmaz will travel to the UK to attend meetings with investors. (Anadolu Agency)

 

Türkiye and Libya committed to enhancing cooperation in the field of vocational and technical education on Thursday under a deal signed by top officials of the two countries. (Habertürk)

 

A Türkiye-U.S. Greentech Delegation meeting was hosted in Ankara by Union of Chambers and Commodity Exchanges of Türkiye (TOBB) Chair Rifat Hisarc1kl1o lu. The meeting was attended by Deputy Trade Minister Mustafa Tuzcu, U.S. Chamber of Commerce Senior Vice President Marty Durbin, and Senior Advisor Ambassador David Thome. Hisarc1kl1o lu said, "We invite U.S. investors to invest more in Türkiye. Our bilateral trade volume reached $33 billion in 2023. Türkiye and the U.S. have targeted boosting bilateral trade to $100 billion. We believe this trade target is achievable." Thorne said the GreenTech partnership between the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and TOBB is important and that they want this partnership to continue with a green agenda. Durbin said the chamber has set ambitious goals for Türkiye and the U.S. on green transformation, emissions reductions, and climate change. (Hürriyet)

 

Daily Sabah columnist Hakk1 Öcal wrote, Russian President Vladimir Putin's delay of his scheduled Türkiye visit, the U.S. administration s decision and Congress's approval to sell Türkiye new F-16 aircraft and modernization kits, U.S. Ambassador to Ankara Jeff Flake's Deseret News piece, and a Donald Trump-affiliated and church-related Utah outlet explaining how it is essential to preserve U.S.-Turkish ties have all inspired a bayram havas1 (festive atmosphere) in some Turkish and American circles.

 

DOMESTIC POLITICS

 

Speaking in Bal1kesir, President Erdo an criticized the opposition and said, "Since everything is secretive in the opposition, it is a mystery who walks with whom and who owes whom. Seeking reconciliation with Qandil [the PKK] by calling it urban reconciliation shows that the CHP has nothing in common with this country and this nation. The CHP has ceased to be a playmaker and has become a pawn in the established games." (NTV)

 

Campaigning in Sakarya, President Erdo an continued to target the CHP. Taking aim at Ankara Mayor Mansur Yava_ and Istanbul Mayor Ekrem 0mamo lu, Erdo an said, "It s not clear what will happen to those who they were passing around as vice presidents [last year]. They don't care if the apocalypse breaks out, if the nation cries out. They don t see anything other than their own personal careers." (BirGün)

 

At a campaign event, CHP Chair Özgür Özel said, Don t let the person responsible for the 0liç disaster cause another disaster in Istanbul. (BirGün)

 

Stating that they oppose the alliance system and caused discomfort among those who benefit from it, 0Y0 Party leader Meral Ak_ener Ak_ener said that they were the only political party able to kickstart the democratic national rise that Türkiye deserves. (Karar)

 

Gazete Pencere columnist Nuray Babacan wrote that President Erdo an is not satisfied with the local election rallies held so far.

 

Former Diyarbak1r Metropolitan Co-Mayor Selçuk M1zrakl1, who was arrested after being replaced by a trustee, rejected the earthquake housing lottery. AFAD said, "You have an application, apply to the governorship for cancellation." (BirGün)

 

When the CHP and Can Atalay's lawyers filed an application over the parliamentary seat of Atalay, who was sentenced to imprisonment in the Gezi Park trial, being revoked, the Constitutional Court ruled that there was no need for a decision. On the decision, Justice Minister Y1lmaz Tunç said, "The Constitutional Court should have rejected the application due to lack of jurisdiction." (Hürriyet)

 

The sentences given in the case over a 6-year-old being married off in 0stanbul were overturned. An appeals court reversed the verdict, saying that Kadir 0stekli, who was sentenced to 30 years, should have been sentenced for two crimes but was sentenced for only one, and that the sentences of the mother and father Fatima Gümü_el and Yusuf Ziya Gümü_el should be increased as they are the girl s parents. The defendants will be retried in the coming days. (Milliyet)

 

The Council of Judges and Prosecutors published a decree on the appointment of 148 judges, prosecutors, and administrative judge candidates in the Official Gazette. (TRT Haber)

 

THE ECONOMY

 

Türkiye has largely met the criteria set by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) on money laundering and terrorism financing. (NTV)

 

Goldman Sachs analyzed the interest rate decision announced by the Central Bank and predicted that the rate of appreciation in the Turkish lira will continue in 2024. The bank also stated that the Central Bank's reserves will turn positive as a result of the right steps taken. (Ak_am)

 

The World Bank has approved a ¬600 million loan to Türkiye as part of the Türkiye Green Export Project. (T24)

On a project to be implemented by the state-owned bank that supports the country's exporters, and aiming to back their green transition, Türkiye's treasury chief pledged to continue mobilizing capabilities for exporters. (Sabah)

 

Economists taking part in an Anadolu Agency survey said they estimate the Turkish economy grew 3.97% in the fourth quarter of last year. (Anadolu Agency)

 

Türkiye attracted nearly 2.1 million foreign visitors in January, up 2.05% year-on-year, according to official data. (Sözcü)

 

Istanbul s Galata Tower will be closed to visitors for one month due to earthquake reinforcement and exterior facade repair. During the work, no harm will be done to the nearly 400 migratory bird nests on the tower's body walls. (Ayd1nl1k)

 

TÜRK 0^ Union Director General Pevrul Kavlak has died due to an illness. (BirGün)

 

SECURITY NEWS

 

National Intelligence Organization (M0T) head Ibrahim Kal1n said that the organization works for Türkiye in many critical moves, from foreign policy to the fight against terrorism. Mentioning the recent operation against the Israeli secret service, Kal1n said, "Türkiye demonstrates seriously in every case that it is not a free field for espionage." (NTV)

 

Speaking to CNN Türk, Turkish Aerospace Industries Corporation (TAI) CEO Temel Kotil said that the national combat aircraft KAAN is a 5th-generation aircraft that can take on Russian SU57s as well as U.S. F-22s and F-35s. (Milliyet)

 

Communications Director Fahrettin Altun said Türkiye has been rapidly boosting its military deterrence capabilities, as the country's first homegrown fighter jet KAAN completed its maiden flight. (TRT Haber)

 

In an operation across 9 provinces based in 0stanbul, 18 suspects were arrested in "Private Houses where the FETÖ [Gülenist group] had prepared for the 2013-2014 KPSS exam. (Karar)

 

Four PKK terrorists were neutralized in the area of Operation Claw-Kilit in northern Iraq, said the Defense Ministry. (Milliyet)

 

The Defense Ministry announced that 4 PKK terrorists detected in northern Iraq s Gara region were neutralized with an air operation. (Milliyet)

 

In a joint National Intelligence Organization (M0T)-police operation, Murat K1z1l, codenamed Mazlum Mardin, a ringleader of the terrorist group PKK/KCK, was captured while trying to flee to Europe. (Ak_am)

 

Interior Minister Ali Yerlikaya announced that three organized crime syndicates have been brought down and that 47 suspects, including the ringleaders, have been arrested in Operation Cage-46 raids held simultaneously in Ayd1n and Bursa. (Yeni Akit)

 

WHAT IS EXPECTED?

 

President Erdo an will attend the opening ceremony of the Sirkeci-Kazl1çe_me Rail System and Pedestrian Oriented Next Generation Transportation Project, the expanded provincial election affairs heads meeting at the AK Party Congress Center, and a Central Executive Committee meeting at AK Party Headquarters.

 

Vice President Cevdet Y1lmaz will meet with representatives of the Turkish business world in the UK.

 

At the International Court of Justice (ICJ) hearing on the legal consequences of Israel's occupation of Palestine, a delegation headed by Deputy FM Ahmet Y1ld1z will make a presentation on behalf of Turkey.

 

FM Hakan Fidan will meet with Mexican FM Alicia Barcena.

 

CHP leader Özgür Özel will chair Central Executive Board and Party Assembly meetings at party headquarters.

 

Justice Minister Y1lmaz Tunç will attend a mediation and arbitration information seminar for judges in Ankara.

 

Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change Minister Mehmet Özhaseki will visit historical Grand Bazaar tradesmen in Kahramanmara_ and attend the opening of the Pazarc1k district election office.

 

Industry and Technology Minister Mehmet Fatih Kac1r will attend the Global Clean Technologies Entrepreneurship Program-Turkey 2023 Accelerator Award Ceremony.
